encounter: P12 play_order 140, E0166 TRAINER_GEORGE (Petalburg Gym room 3 - the fortress with a clock), cap 42
availability_audit: Petalburg Gym is challenged in C27 and the cap is still 42 until Norman's badge at the end of the Gym. No Surf. Every member is in work/reference-pools/pool-42.json with gate <= 42 and a source map walked by C26. Medichamite stone-window 14 and Medicham base-window 42, both cleared; Mega Ring from Steven in C13. Route 118 and New Mauville sources excluded. No legendary, mythical or Paradox species; Kartana is an Ultra Beast, permitted above the cap-24 window, native to Petalburg Woods from C05.
plan: George's room wins on attrition and a Curse clock, and the dossier names the counterplay precisely: Taunt shuts Cotton Guard, Curse, Heal Pulse, Soft-Boiled, Thunder Wave and Encore all at once, and a Fighting attacker beats six Normal types. This party brings both, plus the specific answer to the Defense-stacking half of the room. Mega Medicham's Pure Power doubles its Attack and High Jump Kick is 2x into every single member of George's six. Kartana's Sacred Sword is the technical answer: it ignores the target's Defense stat changes, so Dubwool's Cotton Guard and Snorlax's Curse do not reduce it at all. Prankster Sableye gets Taunt out before any of the slow walls move. Incineroar's Knock Off is the other lever - it removes Chansey's Eviolite, Snorlax's Leftovers and Miltank's Choice Band, all of which this room depends on. Chandelure is here for Dubwool specifically: Fluffy doubles Fire damage taken, so Flamethrower into Dubwool is effectively a 2x hit on a body that is otherwise built to ignore contact attacks. Togekiss is immune to High Horsepower and Stomping Tantrum. Noted in advance: Miltank's Scrappy means Ghost typing does NOT blank its Normal moves, so Sableye is not safe from it, and Komala's Comatose makes it immune to every status this party can apply.
